description.pl: Gmail (czytanie, szkice), Kalendarz (odczyt), Dysk, Dokumenty i Arkusze Google.
description.en: Gmail (reading, drafts), Calendar (read), Drive, Docs and Sheets.

help.pl: W console.cloud.google.com utworz projekt, wlacz Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs i Sheets API, skonfiguruj ekran zgody OAuth (dodaj siebie jako uzytkownika testowego) i utworz klienta OAuth typu Aplikacja internetowa z adresem przekierowania https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground.
help.en: In console.cloud.google.com create a project, enable the Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs and Sheets APIs, configure the OAuth consent screen (add yourself as a test user) and create a Web application OAuth client with the redirect URI https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground.
The secret of the same OAuth client.

help.pl: W OAuth 2.0 Playground (ikona zebatki) zaznacz "Use your own OAuth credentials" i wpisz Client ID oraz sekret. Wybierz zakresy: documents, spreadsheets, drive, gmail.readonly, gmail.compose, calendar.readonly. Kliknij Authorize APIs, potem Exchange authorization code for tokens i skopiuj Refresh token.
help.en: In the OAuth 2.0 Playground (gear icon) tick "Use your own OAuth credentials" and enter the Client ID and secret. Pick the scopes: documents, spreadsheets, drive, gmail.readonly, gmail.compose, calendar.readonly. Click Authorize APIs, then Exchange authorization code for tokens and copy the Refresh token.
